method: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md before analysis. Inspected individual source control flow; decoded Base64/Gzip/raw-Deflate PEs; disassembled managed IL with dnfile/dncil; traced native code with rizin and Capstone, resolving import/GOT/PLT targets where required. Ran atomscan --no-update --mode slow --format json path --follow=none on every available member before and after trait changes, and cleave facts on every available member plus decoded payloads. Samples were not executed and remote payloads were not fetched. ML scores were not verdict evidence.
archive_verdicts: All three supplied .deb SHA256 hashes verified. Confirmed archive convictions preserved; no archive re-judgment markers written.
layout: Original extraction omitted the data/ prefix. Listed members were copied byte-for-byte into their exact requested data/usr/... paths and SHA256 checked. The listed data.tar.gz was recovered from the Mettle gem and matched 78dbe1c203e15f048589a5c3610e318968cb9a3dac003abe623929774ba73d1a. Markers are beside those exact extracted member paths.
trait_changes: Moved __InstanceModificationEvent, Win32_ProcessStartTrace and __IntervalTimerInstruction literal observations from persistence objectives to micro-behaviors/os/wmi/query. Preserved literal matchers/type scope, renamed them as class-name references, made them notable, removed signing downgrades and persistence ATT&CK/MBC defaults.

Moved the three Set-WmiInstance object-creation observations from persistence objectives to micro-behaviors/os/wmi/event with the original content matchers and file/platform scope, at notable severity and without persistence ATT&CK/MBC defaults.
Removed the redundant wmi-startup-query OR finding; expanded its exact three alternatives at its sole remaining consumer without changing the OR threshold.

Replaced ps-wmi-processstart-kill with a notable WMI event composite explicitly describing command-consumer/process-start-query co-occurrence. Its required evidence established no process termination.
Removed windows-wmi-persistence from registry startup rules: it duplicated an OR over WMI object-creation atoms and established neither registry startup nor complete persistence.

The PowerShell WMI persistence composite now requires all three subscription objects and independent concealed-profile persistence context, and describes their co-occurrence. Restricted its type to PowerShell because its context cannot match Batch/VBS. Ordinary event monitors no longer receive a hostile persistence finding; Persistence.psm1 retains both supported hostile persistence detections.

reference_audit.exact_consumers: Updated go WMI command-persistence and PowerShell WMI subscription references. No active YAML references remain to removed IDs. Historical review JSON remains a historical snapshot.
reference_audit.ancestor_consumers: Audited selectors of moved source/destination paths and all ancestors. The sole destination query-directory selector is wmi-host-profile-queries, scoped to PE/DLL; new source-only observations cannot satisfy it. No broader source or destination ancestor selectors were found. No new grouping composite was added to the query subtree, avoiding double-counted alternatives.

focused_checks.result: 6 fixtures passed: instance query, process query, timer class, filter-only creation, legitimate command event monitor, and unrelated WMI query. No fixture has hostile/suspicious findings. Actual Persistence.psm1 rescan retains two hostile findings and only one unrelated suspicious profile finding.

members.behavior: Base64/Gzip wrapper loads WireT4p and invokes Main. IL Main dispatches to password-phrase speech recognition, audio recording, screen/webcam capture and keyboard capture. StartKeylogger installs SetWindowsHookEx and file trace listeners; its callback writes keys, window titles and times.

Reflective PE loader maps embedded native Mimikatz, clears both MZ bytes and invokes exported code with sekurlsa::logonpasswords or crypto::cng/crypto::capi and certificate /export commands. The executable paths recover LSASS credentials and bypass private-key export protections.

Writes a patched hijack DLL and a self-deleting batch launcher, selects sysprep/cliconfg auto-elevation paths, then injects the helper into a newly launched hidden notepad process to install and invoke the elevated DLL.

Enumerates domain users, reflectively maps native Mimikatz, erases its MZ magic, issues lsadump::dcsync /user commands and parses returned NTLM hashes. This is domain secret replication abuse, not just a DCSync name reference.

Invoke-CallbackIEX fetches callback content, decodes it and evaluates it. CallbackLoop repeatedly calls this path; packet-knock, DNS, event and bind triggers activate the same remote execution facility.

Loads embedded SweetPotato and calls its Main. IL enables impersonation privileges, triggers DCOM/WinRM/PrintSpoofer authentication interception, obtains and duplicates the intercepted token and launches the selected program in that security context.

Gzip/Base64 assembly calls RegQueryValueDemo.Main. Its DoStuff saves remote SAM and SECURITY hives, retrieves them through ADMIN$, derives the boot key and invokes ParseSam/ParseLsa to recover hashes and LSA secrets before cleanup and reporting.

CreateProcessWithLogonW is used to leak a privileged thread handle. The script suspends and impersonates the thread, duplicates its SYSTEM token and races SetThreadToken against suspended logon process creation, resuming the resulting SYSTEM shell.

Reflectively loads embedded VNC remote-control images and supplies bind-port/password configuration. The loader erases PE magic before mapping and starts the payload, providing remote desktop access through an injected image.

Constructs a child PowerShell command that disables certificate verification, downloads text with WebClient and immediately Invoke-Expression evaluates it. Starts that child hidden with a Metasploit web-delivery cradle.

PowerUp implements service command substitution and execution followed by restoration, DLL/installer abuse helpers and credential extraction. Its SiteList path decrypts stored passwords and returns plaintext; its GPP path also reads and decrypts cpassword entries.
CredManMain calls Enum-Creds, whose CredEnumerate wrapper returns CredentialBlob values. The top-level code invokes CredManMain and prints each stored username, plaintext password blob and target.

Injects an embedded NetRipper DLL via remote allocation/write/thread execution. Native hook paths around 0x10002d80 and 0x10002de0 copy plaintext SSL write/read buffers to logging functions; configuration filters sensitive terms including password and credential.

Selects an existing Winlogon or clones a suspended one using a SYSTEM token, reflectively injects a native logon helper and writes domain, username, password, logon type and authentication package into its named pipe for LsaLogonUser inside Winlogon.
Writes a hidden encoded PowerShell launcher under the per-user mscfile command association, starts eventvwr.exe to obtain auto-elevated execution, then removes the override and payload property.

Constructs a DLL from compressed bytes and patches the new account/password fields. Supplies this DLL as the printer driver configuration through AddPrinterDriverEx flags that cause privileged loading; the embedded payload creates a local administrator account.

Uses a RAW printer document and WritePrinter to place an embedded DLL into System32 through a configured output port. Also writes a Run-key launcher for hidden encoded PowerShell, enabling elevated execution and persistence.

Loads a managed SpoolSample launcher. Main passes target/capture-server arguments to an embedded native DoStuff export. That export parses the pair and calls NdrClientCall3 with printer Open/notification operations 1 and 0x41, directing the target to authenticate to the capture server.

HTTP handlers parse NTLM authentication and format/queue captured NetNTLMv2 records. The relay state machine forwards authentication into SMB service-control operations, creates an operator command service and starts it.
Two elevation paths: creates a SYSTEM service that connects to a named pipe and invokes ImpersonateNamedPipeClient, or obtains, duplicates and impersonates a token from a SYSTEM process.

ElevatePrivs opens LSASS, duplicates its token and assigns it to the current thread. The registry path obtains SAM F/V records and the LSA boot key, applies RC4/AES and RID-derived DES decryption and returns local account hashes.

Decompresses and loads SharpChromium. Wrapper retrieves saved logins, cookies and browser history; serializes credentials/cookies to output. Managed ChromiumCredentialManager queries cookies from a temporary database copy and decrypts stored secrets.

Enumerates saved PuTTY, RDP, WinSCP and FileZilla sessions locally or remotely. FileZilla parsing Base64-decodes saved passwords and WinSCP paths decrypt stored credentials; results include connection identities and secrets.

Duplicates and impersonates an LSASS token for SAM access. Reads the selected account F record, overwrites its RID identity bytes (offsets 48/49) with the requested privileged RID and writes the altered record back to SAM.

Installs a hidden encoded PowerShell command in the per-user exefile runas IsolatedCommand association and starts sdclt.exe /kickoffelev. Removes the hijacked association and stored command afterward.

Opens the remote SCM, creates a command service with CreateServiceA, starts it and deletes it. Optional execution/result paths copy files through administrative shares; the service is an ephemeral remote command launcher.

Creates the per-user ms-settings command association and empty DelegateExecute property, assigns a hidden encoded PowerShell launcher and starts fodhelper.exe for auto-elevation, then removes the override.

Writes an operator-controlled hidden PowerShell command into HKCU Environment windir and runs the SilentCleanup scheduled task with schtasks. Restores the modified environment and payload properties afterward.

Loads SharpLoginPrompt. IL Main repeatedly shows a native Windows credential prompt, unpacks the authentication buffer, prints Username/Password/Domain in plaintext and validates the credentials before ending the prompt loop.
Builds a Groovy ProcessBuilder command from operator input and posts it to the Jenkins script console. Reads the response and extracts the command Result output for the operator.

Continuously polls GetAsyncKeyState, translates keystrokes using GetKeyboardState/ToUnicode, associates them with the foreground window and emits captured text. This is recording, not merely keyboard event handling.
Uses an HTTP HEAD request to JBoss JMX MainDeployer invokeOp with an operator-supplied WAR location, waits for deployment, then sends GET to the deployed application JSP to activate the payload.

Poisons NBNS resolution and induces local authentication, reflects captured NTLM authentication to loopback SMB and uses the relay service-control path to execute a command at higher privilege. Scheduled-task triggers can induce the authentication.

members.note: Persistence.psm1: classify WMI observations by operation
members.behavior: Compresses and Base64-wraps operator script, installs a decoding/evaluation payload into PowerShell profiles with whitespace concealment, and generates permanent WMI filter/command-consumer/binding code. Also supports Run and scheduled-task triggers and SSP installation.

Invoke-AsSystem opens Winlogon and impersonates its token. Get-NTLMLocalPasswordHashes reads SAM F/V and LSA key-class data, derives boot/SAM keys, decrypts hash data and returns usernames/RIDs/NTLM hashes.

Constructs raw SMB/NTLM authentication and service-control RPC messages, creates an operator command service on the remote target, starts it and removes the service. Supports hash-based authentication and SMB session state.

Recursively searches domain-controller SYSVOL preference XML files, extracts cpassword attributes, decodes Base64 and decrypts them with the published GPP AES key, then returns recovered passwords and usernames.

Enumerates domain accounts and lockout policy, removes disabled or near-lockout accounts, repeatedly attempts DirectoryEntry binds with one password across many users and reports/writes successful username-password pairs.

Loads embedded System.Data.SQLite, queries Chrome Login Data, decrypts password_value using DPAPI CurrentUser and emits or stages plaintext usernames/passwords. Also reads and exports browser history.

Impersonates application/update notifications and Windows credential dialogs, optionally hides windows, unpacks entered credentials and reprompts until validated credentials can be returned as phishing output.
Implements LLMNR/NBNS spoofing and SMB/HTTP authentication capture. Parses challenge/response data, builds NetNTLMv2 cracking records and queues or writes the captured authentication material.

Raw-Deflate/Base64-decodes the embedded ETW keylogger assembly, creates UsbEventSource and calls startkeyLog. Drains keysPressed into a text buffer with foreground window titles and timestamps and returns the recorded keys.

Finds elevated process tokens, duplicates one, lowers the duplicate integrity level and creates a restricted token; impersonates the resulting context and uses CreateProcessWithLogonW to start the supplied command through the UAC token bypass.
Builds bitmap read/write primitives through win32k pointer corruption, walks the kernel process list, obtains the SYSTEM process token and writes it into the PowerShell process token field.

Enumerates process/thread tokens, impersonates SYSTEM to access more tokens, duplicates a selected identity token and either impersonates it or starts a child with CreateProcessAsUserW/CreateProcessWithTokenW. Also adjusts desktop ACLs for the stolen-token child.

Creates an MSBuild inline C# task that Base64-decodes a command and invokes it through a PowerShell runspace. Writes the project locally or through an administrative share and invokes MSBuild through WMI process creation before removing the project.

Reads Firefox saved logins, loads NSS and calls PK11SDR_Decrypt for encryptedUsername/encryptedPassword. Formats the recovered URL/username/password records and emits or writes them to a plaintext file.

Sweeps user/program directories for SiteList.xml, extracts stored account/password fields, reverses the fixed XOR transform and decrypts TripleDES data with the derived static key; returns decrypted site credentials.

Test-directory copy remains executable: reflectively maps embedded Mimikatz, clears PE magic and dispatches LSASS logon-password recovery or private-key export bypass commands. Its embedded PE bytes differ from the server copy.

Empire task packet decoder dispatches remote task data to PowerShell execution/jobs, shell commands and file transfer. Encrypts result packets and sends them back; file download reads and transmits local file chunks to the controller.

IronPython agent dispatches numbered controller tasks, compiles/executes received Python or invokes PowerShell runspaces, captures stdout and sends response packets. Its file transfer path reads and returns local files in chunks.

Python agent process_packet dispatches received tasks to compile/exec and shell=True subprocess paths. Captures output and sends response packets; file_download reads local files and transmits chunks to the controller.

Native Empire stager downloads bytes with WinHTTP, optionally disables certificate checks, copies the exact response buffer into PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE memory and transfers execution to it through CreateFiber/SwitchToFiber.

Classic ASP command form reads Request.Form .CMD, concatenates it into cmd.exe /c and runs it hidden through WScript.Shell. Returns temporary-file command output to HTTP and deletes the temporary output file.

PHP request c reaches system() directly. Other request modes expose arbitrary file reads, directory browsing, uploaded-file placement and operator-supplied SQL queries; no authentication boundary protects these webshell operations.
Perl CGI reads QUERY_STRING, decodes spaces and semicolons, executes the result with backticks and prints command output into the HTTP response. No authentication is performed.

Gzip contains a native ELF shared object. Its constructor clears LD_PRELOAD and forks; the child creates a TCP listener on configurable port text 55555, accepts a client, dup2 maps the accepted descriptor to 0/1/2 and execl launches a shell from its fallback table. The parent exits. Per-file disassembly verifies the listener-to-shell path.

Payload container includes executable Mettle/Meterpreter implants across architectures and a Ruby payload configuration API. In x86_64-linux-musl mettle, tlv_dispatcher_process_request selects and invokes a command handler (0x1289a); sys_process_execute reads requested executable/arguments from TLV fields and calls process_new, then returns a channel/result. C2/session and filesystem/process command handlers establish an implant, independent of ordinary bundled libraries and sniffer utilities.
